home.title: Jera Labs | Digital systems built to grow smarter
home.description: We design digital systems that help companies grow more intelligently. Development, automation, and applied AI.

whatWeSolve.title: What we solve | Jera Labs
whatWeSolve.description: Operational, integration, and growth problems we can help you solve.

howWeWork.title: How we work | Jera Labs
howWeWork.description: Our approach to understanding your business and designing technology solutions with judgment.

about.title: About | Jera Labs
about.description: Meet Jera Labs: a technology studio connecting business, marketing, and technology.

contact.title: Contact | Jera Labs
contact.description: Tell us what problem you want to solve. Let’s start by understanding the context.

Footer.description: A technology studio designing simple, efficient, and scalable digital systems.
Footer.runeNote: Jera is the rune of good harvest and cycles that complete.

Hero.title: We design digital systems for companies that want to grow more intelligently.
Hero.description: We combine development, automation, and artificial intelligence to turn complex processes into simple, efficient, and scalable solutions.

SystemProblem.title: Most companies don’t need more tools. They need better systems.
SystemProblem.description: When processes depend on manual work, scattered information, and disconnected tools, growth becomes slower, more expensive, and harder to manage.

ProblemSolutions.title: Problems we can help you solve
ProblemSolutions.description: We don’t start from a specific tool. First we understand what’s holding the business back, then we design the right solution.

repetitiveOps.title: Repetitive operations
repetitiveOps.body: We automate tasks that consume time and reduce the team’s capacity to focus on important decisions.

disconnectedSystems.title: Disconnected systems
disconnectedSystems.body: We integrate tools, data, and channels so operations work as a system instead of isolated pieces.

messyCommercial.title: Disorganized commercial processes
messyCommercial.body: We design flows, CRM, and automations that organize prospect and customer follow-up.

ideasToValidate.title: Ideas that need validation
ideasToValidate.body: We build landing pages and MVPs to turn an idea into a working solution that can be tested in the market.

hardToUseInfo.title: Information that’s hard to use
hardToUseInfo.body: We create dashboards, panels, and internal systems that turn scattered data into clear information.

opsLimitedGrowth.title: Growth limited by operations
opsLimitedGrowth.body: We optimize processes and digital architecture so the company can grow without unnecessarily multiplying complexity.

ThinkingProcess.title: The solution starts before choosing the technology.

understand.title: Understand
understand.body: We grasp the business, its operations, and the real problem.

analyze.title: Analyze
analyze.body: We identify causes, dependencies, friction points, and opportunities.

design.title: Design
design.body: We define a viable, simple solution adapted to the context.

build.title: Build
build.body: We develop and integrate the required components.

evolve.title: Evolve
evolve.body: We measure, learn, and propose improvements when they add value.

Capabilities.title: What we can build together
Capabilities.description: Each project may need a different mix of development, automation, and integration.

FoundersPreview.title: Two perspectives. One system.
FoundersPreview.description: Jera Labs is born from the union of development and digital operations.
FoundersPreview.bridge: Together we approach every project from three dimensions: business, experience, and technology.

alejandro.name: Alejandro Lucas
alejandro.body: Turns ideas and needs into functional products and interfaces.

karla.name: Karla Vázquez
karla.body: Connects tools, automates processes, and designs commercial and operational systems.

JeraMeaning.title: Growth is also a system.
JeraMeaning.description: Jera is the Nordic rune associated with harvest, cycles, and results achieved through a constant process. It represents how we understand technology: build solid foundations, improve continuously, and create solutions that can grow with the business.

FinalCta.title: Tell us what problem you want to solve.
FinalCta.description: You don’t need to know which technology to use. Let’s start by understanding the problem and evaluate the best way to approach it together.

Contact.title: Let’s talk about your project
Contact.description: Tell us what you’re trying to solve. We’ll follow up to understand the context and propose a next step.
